instrument: float32 inference; unit-drive baselines; DrivAerML surface pressure rel-L2, 48 validation cars, 10,000 cells; seed means

columns.in_family: pressure rel-L2 on the 48 validation cars (sampling uniform over cells, 10k)
columns.density_factor: pressure rel-L2 under 10:1 front/back Poisson-biased sampling (exact HT measure weights) ÷ uniform, 10k cells (campaign E, research/transfer_program/studies/campaign_e_evalonly/campaign_e_density_fp32_2026-09-09.json)
columns.pose_factor: pressure rel-L2 with every training and validation case in its own random SO(3) pose ÷ canonical-pose error of the same architecture (POSE-BENCH, research/transfer_program/studies/campaign_b_pose/campaign_b_fp32_2026-09-10.json); baselines trained with SO(3) augmentation
columns.zero_shot_fastback: pressure rel-L2 on the 99 SHIFT-SUV fastback validation cases, no fastback training data (1.0 = predicting the mean; transfer session float32 evaluations under snapshot code)
columns.few_shot_gain: fine-tuned on 20 fastback cases for 1,000 steps at matched learning rate: error from scratch ÷ error fine-tuned − 1 (campaign C T3, #sec-nb-campc-t3-verdict)

isla_similarity_gauge.label: ISLA, similarity gauge (lr 3e-3; other rows 1e-3 except Transolver)
isla_similarity_gauge.lr_note: trained at 3e-3; rate-matched constant gauge mt2_v3c_seed42 scores 0.0620 fp32, so no in-distribution price is established on DrivAerML (#sec-nb-gauge-lr-confound)

isla_weights_off_ablation.label: ISLA, measure weights off (ablation, not adopted; lr 1e-3)

geotransolver_unit.label: GeoTransolver, unit drive (lr 1e-3)
geotransolver_unit.pose_note: with SO(3) augmentation; unaugmented degrades far more

hilift_pending: HiLift density and area-resampling factors come from the consistency benchmark (#sec-nb-bench-prereg); until it lands the HiLift rows carry accuracy only
notes: The ISLA pose factor is 1.01 by construction (exact SE(3) covariance) and measured; the similarity gauge and weights-off rows inherit it.

scale_corner.description: the 512-wide, 80,000-cell corner of the scaling study (SCALE), float32, unit drive, DrivAerML 48 cars evaluated at 80,000 cells; density factor = biased ÷ uniform at the corner's own cell count (results/scaling/*_scale_reduction_2026-09-09.json, scaling synthesis a6c8a6058)

isla_similarity_gauge_512x80k.label: ISLA, similarity gauge, 512 × 80k (fast kernel)
isla_similarity_gauge_512x80k.note: the only scaled configuration whose accuracy survives the density bias; adopted at scale under the principle (scaling synthesis, psharpe/mesh-transformer 15ee3df40)
